deaths.cause: a toad like a war drum, throat swelling

beats.text: 📯 The Bloodied's court summons Haven's speaker. SWEAR the oath of the realm (a gift seals it), SERVE at their court (seven days of your speaker's life), or WALK — break the link and stay a free fire, refusing the scale itself with it (the offer does not return). Or REFUSE the scale itself — stay a free fire at regional, whatever that costs. The System will not offer twice.
With Haven grieving, The Bloodied installs their own speaker at the table. Tribute rises to 7,500 kcal/week. Grief is leverage, and they know it. The link holds — it was never with one person.
With Haven grieving, The Bloodied installs their own speaker at the table. Tribute rises to 11,250 kcal/week. Grief is leverage, and they know it. The link holds — it was never with one person.

With Haven grieving again, The Bloodied installs their own speaker at the table — and reaches for the grief card once more. The table has heard it before: the grief card is spent. Tribute stays at 11,250 kcal/week. The link holds — it was never with one person.
